ActivityFlow provides a flexible specification and restructuring framework for workflow activities.

ActivityFlow is a specification language that allows for flexible specification, incremental composition, and incremental restructuring of workflow activities, and that ActivityFlow is implemented as a workflow management system that supports the execution of workflow activities in a collaborative environment.

the development of a flexible and open architecture for workflow management systems that can be used to support the specification of workflow activities, their incremental and dynamic restructuring, and their collaboration with other workflow systems.
the design of workflow systems that are capable of handling dynamic changes in a flexible way.
a new approach to the specification, composition, coordination, and restructuring of workflow activities in a systematic manner.

ActivityFlow provides a flexible, extensible, and open architecture for the development and management of workflow activities, and it can serve as a foundation to build workflow management systems for the next generation.
the proposed ActivityFlow language and its underlying implementation architecture are a significant step towards the realization of flexible workflow processes.
the proposed ActivityFlow specification language is an important step towards the development of flexible workflow systems.

the ActivityFlow specification and implementation framework provides a systematic approach to flexible specification, composition and restructuring of workflow activities.
the ActivityFlow system provides an effective approach to flexible workflow specification, composition, execution, and restructuring.

the use of a uniform workflow specification language for different types of workflow activities, as well as the use of a collection of workflow activity restructuring mechanisms, can significantly improve the flexibility and robustness of the underlying workflow systems.
